title: Audio-Language Models: the Whisper to Audio Flamingo 3 Arc

questions.question: Upgrading the audio model degrades accuracy though weights improved. The framing changed silently. What prevents that?
options: Bigger models to absorb mismatch
Trust in default framing
Faster inference hardware
Window and hop versioned with the model
questions.explanation: Features and models version together. This lesson frames audio consistently across the lineage.

questions.question: What length does apply_mel return when given a 64-bin spectrum and the default mel_filterbank(n_bins=64, n_mels=20)?
options: 64, because each mel filter preserves one spectrum bin
10, because the hop size is 10ms
1, because all frequencies are pooled into one energy
20, one energy value for each triangular filter row
questions.explanation: mel_filterbank creates 20 rows, and apply_mel computes one weighted sum per row. The log-Mel vector therefore has length 20.

questions.question: What does log_compress([0.0]) return?
options: [0.0], because log(1 + 0) is zero
[0.0, 0.0], because every value is duplicated
[1.0], because log compression adds a unit floor
An exception, because logarithms cannot receive zero
questions.explanation: The helper applies math.log(1+x), not log(x). At x=0, log(1)=0, so the compressed value remains zero.

questions.question: What shape does QFormer(n_queries=8, hidden=20).forward(frames) return for 99 frames?
options: 99 vectors of dimension 20, because every frame is preserved
8 vectors of dimension 20, each query pooling over all frames
20 vectors of dimension 8, because hidden is the query count
One scalar, because attention averages every dimension
questions.explanation: Each of the eight learnable queries computes weights over the 99 frames and produces one 20-dimensional weighted aggregate.

questions.question: Which task in task_coverage_table is marked unavailable to the cascaded Whisper-then-LLM path but available end-to-end?
options: Transcription
Keyword extraction
Emotion inference
Summarization
questions.explanation: Emotion inference is listed as 'no' for cascaded and 'yes' for end-to-end. The acoustic cue is not recoverable from a transcript alone.

questions.question: Why does the lesson favor end-to-end audio-LLM training for acoustic-only tasks?
options: Whisper cannot produce any text tokens
A cascaded pipeline always has lower latency and higher coverage
The Q-Former removes all temporal information from audio
Transcripts lose cues such as emotion, instruments, environment, and deepfake artifacts that remain in the waveform
questions.explanation: The coverage table marks acoustic-only tasks such as emotion, instrument, environmental sound, and deepfake detection as unavailable or partial in the cascade. End-to-end features retain those cues.
